product_metadata.title: Sweese 404.602 Porcelain Stackable Espresso Cups with Saucers and Metal Stand - 2.5 Ounce for Specialty Coffee Drinks, Latte, Cafe Mocha and Tea - Set of 6, Turquoise
features: Have A Coffee House Experience - A Simple yet classy design that perfectly fits your espresso maker. Coming with Saucers and the great stacking stand. The walls of the cups are relatively thick, so they retain heat. They have a cafe look that actually makes you feel as though you are in a coffee bar enjoying your brew.

This Set Is Very Much A Space Saver - Porcelain cup/saucer set with a bonus stacking rack to keep the set together, takes the same space as one saucer. It's compact enough to fit in the smallest cabinet or take up very little counter (or table) real estate. If you are a space-saver or have compulsive OCD about keeping your apartment neat and tidy, this is that neat look that you want.

Bright Turquoise Coloring - Sweese porcelain cups have industry-favorite traditional contours, ideal for various dining environments, from casual to the white tablecloth. The sleek cups are sure to create a dining experience your guests won't soon forget.
Pro-Grade Porcelain - These Sweese espresso cups are made of durable porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE, and can be used for dishwasher, microwave, oven and freezer.
Ideal Design For Everyday Use - These coffee cups are smart size with 2.5 oz, set of 6, perfect for tasting a single shot of espresso, works great with an espresso machine.
description: The whole idea was to save space on the counter. If you’re looking for something we could put right beside the espresso machine, something that would take up a minimal amount of counter space. This is that neat look that you want.
They are packaged in a well-wrapped box, a perfect gift for your friends and family on Housewarming, Wedding party, Mothers' Day, Fathers' Day, Christmas and New Year's Day.
